materializationPolicy.note: Effective Road LTL v1.5 equals frozen Road LTL v1.4 plus the governed LTL-03 enrichment in this file. All other v1.4 task/object/source content is inherited unchanged.

taskOverrides.label: Create and validate shipment, consignment and transport-document identity
taskOverrides.trigger: Commercial offer or service request is accepted, or a governed transport-document/BOL instance requires creation, ingestion, amendment or validation for execution.
taskOverrides.before: Commercial commitment may exist, but shipment/consignment/document identity or one or more required information objects may be incomplete, unresolved, conflicting or unvalidated.
taskOverrides.event: Shipment/consignment and transport-document information-resolution work is initiated for the applicable document/regime and execution context.
taskOverrides.decision: Are the canonical shipment, consignment, party, reference, handling-unit, line-item, dangerous-goods, instruction and service-window objects sufficiently resolved, associated, validated and traceable for downstream execution?
taskOverrides.rule: Resolve canonical objects before client/runtime mapping; activate regulatory/industry rules only when their applicability is satisfied; unresolved client/runtime labels remain explicit bindings or source-context gaps; do not infer canonical semantics from flat field labels.
taskOverrides.control: Object identity/uniqueness, requiredWhen/prohibitedWhen, cardinality, object association, normalization, field/cross-field/cross-object validation, provenance, source-authority, conflict, confidence and HITL controls.
taskOverrides.clock: Before pickup acceptance and any applicable document, regulatory or client-system cut-off.
taskOverrides.action: Instantiate canonical document/consignment objects; resolve and associate parties, references, handling units, line items, dangerous goods, instructions and service windows; normalize and validate values; resolve or escalate conflicts; determine confidence/HITL; emit governed canonical outputs and explicit client-binding requirements.
taskOverrides.evidence: Versioned transport document and canonical object graph; field/object resolution evidence; source claims; validation results; exception/HITL record; identifier crosswalk; client-binding status; runtime-feedback linkage.
taskOverrides.after: Canonical execution identity and required information objects are VALIDATED, explicitly CLIENT_BINDING_REQUIRED/SOURCE_CONTEXT_PENDING, or BLOCKED with governed exception ownership.
taskOverrides.outcome: One traceable, source-backed information and identity spine that can be decomposed into executor-ready work and projected to Malkom or another runtime without semantic loss.

operationalKnowledgeV2.businessMeaning: Establish and validate the canonical execution identity and information contract that makes a Road LTL shipment and its transport document usable by downstream operational, compliance, commercial and financial work.
operationalKnowledgeV2.why: Downstream execution cannot safely rely on flat document extraction. Parties, references, package/handling hierarchy, commodity/classification and conditional dangerous-goods information must be attached to the correct canonical objects and validated under the active context.
requiredWhen: A new Road LTL shipment/consignment is established for execution.
A BOL/eBOL/consignment-note or equivalent transport-document instance must be created, ingested, amended or validated.
A downstream executor requires canonical shipment/document information not yet validated.
prohibitedWhen: The record is outside Road LTL scope and no Road LTL leg/task specialization applies.
A jurisdiction/regime-specific rule is not applicable to the active context; such rule must not be universalized.
operationalKnowledgeV2.informationResolutionBaselineRef: BOL Information Resolution Baseline v0.1 — Road LTL / Malkom
resolutionWorkflow: Validate document/input integrity and applicable scope.
Instantiate canonical document and consignment objects.
Identify party, reference, handling-unit, line-item, dangerous-goods, instruction and service-window object instances.
Extract or acquire candidate values from permitted evidence sources.
Associate each candidate value to the correct canonical object instance.
Normalize values into canonical domains and units.
Run field, cross-field and cross-object validation.
Resolve source conflicts using authority policy.
Emit validated canonical objects plus explicit binding/pending statuses.
Map only after canonical resolution to client/runtime fields and target systems.
Capture runtime evidence and feedback for governed learning.

criticalResolutionRules.rule: Hazardous indicator, UN/NA identification number, proper shipping name, hazard class/division, packing group where applicable, technical name where conditionally required, inhalation zone where conditionally required, and emergency-response information are one associated conditional object family, not independent universal fields.
Handling Unit Count/Type and Line Item Piece Count are distinct concepts. Resolve hierarchy/association before accepting counts; do not substitute handling units for pieces.
Resolve references as typed Reference objects with value, type/type scheme, issuer/role and related object. Do not treat every identifier as an undifferentiated Reference Number.
Resolve the party role/block first. Address 1/2/3 are layout bindings over canonical address-line and locality semantics, not separate universal business concepts.

explicitBindingOrSourceContextPending: exact Bill To Account Number semantics

knownOpenGates: Resolve source-reported Malkom Accuracy metric numerator/denominator/counting method for values above 100%.
Obtain governing Malkom/client schema for explicit unresolved labels.
Implement Canonical Work Decomposition Contract v1 and WorkDefinition VNext compilation.

downstreamRegressionRequired: LTL-04 — Request pickup and prove shipment readiness
Any downstream consumer of obj-shipment, obj-transport-document, obj-handling-unit or enriched line-item/dangerous-goods information
